name: job-tracker
description: Dev launcher: ensures Ollama is up, then runs the server and client together in one terminal.
author: haolin <haolin5175@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/stage-server.mjs && electron-builder
